title: Views or instants: reproducibility archive for frame-budget allocation in multi-camera path-length measurement
description:
Analysis code, frozen protocols and sealed results for the trajectory-length frame-budget allocation study prepared for Measurement Science and Technology.

The current working manuscript includes a post-v1.0.1 analysis revision. At 84 frames per window, the selected triple at 28 instants gives MAE 9.60 mm against 50.77 mm for seven views at 12 instants. Equal accuracy is not claimed. Exploratory analyses report record-level comparisons, sequence-equal MAE and bias, camera-overlap controls, temporal error increments and a fixed robust-triangulation baseline. The primary single-camera confirmation criterion was not fully met; the secondary ORB criterion passed. Frozen prediction files remain unchanged. The immutable Zenodo v1.0.1 archive predates this working revision.
